52	    """LLMClient over an OpenAI-compatible ``/chat/completions`` endpoint.
53	
54	    ``provider_order`` pins OpenRouter routing to named providers with
55	    fallbacks disabled, so the transfer row is served by one known provider;
56	    ``reasoning_enabled=False`` requests no thinking tokens (logged as a
57	    pareto-session variable). ``transport`` exists for tests only.
58	    """
59	
60	    def __init__(
61	        self,
62	        *,
63	        base_url: str = DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
64	        api_key: str | None = None,
65	        api_key_env: str = API_KEY_ENV,
66	        provider_order: list[str] | None = None,
67	        reasoning_enabled: bool = False,
68	        max_attempts: int = 3,
69	        backoff_seconds: float = 1.0,
70	        timeout_seconds: float = 180.0,
71	        transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None,
72	    ) -> None:
73	        key = api_key if api_key is not None else os.environ.get(api_key_env)
74	        if not key:
75	            raise ValueError(f"no API key: pass api_key or set {api_key_env} (key is never logged)")
76	        self._provider_order = provider_order
77	        self._reasoning_enabled = reasoning_enabled
78	        self._max_attempts = max_attempts
79	        self._backoff_seconds = backoff_seconds
80	        self._client = httpx.Client(
81	            base_url=base_url,
82	            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"},
83	            timeout=timeout_seconds,
84	            transport=transport,
85	        )

91	        model: str,

93	        temperature: float = 0.0,

95	        body: dict[str, Any] = {
96	            "model": model,
97	            "max_tokens": max_tokens,
98	            "temperature": temperature,
99	            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
100	        }
101	        if not self._reasoning_enabled:
102	            body["reasoning"] = {"enabled": False}
103	        if self._provider_order is not None:
104	            body["provider"] = {"order": self._provider_order, "allow_fallbacks": False}
105	        start = time.monotonic()
106	        payload = self._post_with_retries(body)
107	        latency_ms = (time.monotonic() - start) * 1000
108	        return self.parse_payload(payload, fallback_model=model, latency_ms=latency_ms)
109	
110	    def _post_with_retries(self, body: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
111	        last_error: Exception | None = None
112	        for attempt in range(self._max_attempts):
113	            if attempt:
114	                time.sleep(self._backoff_seconds * 2 ** (attempt - 1))
115	            try:
116	                response = self._client.post("/chat/completions", json=body)
117	            except httpx.TransportError as exc:
118	                last_error = exc
119	                continue

121	                last_error = RuntimeError(f"HTTP {response.status_code} from completions endpoint")
122	                continue
123	            if response.status_code != 200:
124	                # Error bodies are provider prose, safe to surface; the key
125	                # lives only in request headers and is never echoed here.

128	                )

133	            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
